items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like, Grant Green didn’t want to come to New York, he was milkman.

ctx.x: It could have been Carter. He was from Cleveland. There was an alto player that was better than him but he refused to leave. He had a big family. Like, Grant Green didn’t want to come to New York, he was milkman. The real start in Kenny Burrell’s family was Bill Burrell.
